name: AirPods
description: Apple AirPods and wireless earbuds TSA carry-on and checked bag rules.

carryOn.reason: AirPods, AirPods Pro, AirPods Max and all wireless earbuds are fully allowed in carry-on bags. The charging case contains a small lithium-ion battery which is permitted in cabin baggage.
conditions: AirPods charging case contains a lithium battery — allowed in carry-on, not recommended for checked baggage.
AirPods Max headband case with larger battery is also carry-on approved.

checkedBag.reason: AirPods themselves are allowed in checked bags, but the charging case contains a lithium-ion battery. Lithium battery devices are best kept in carry-on baggage per FAA guidance to allow crew access in case of fire.
conditions: AirPods charging case with lithium battery is technically allowed in checked bags but FAA strongly recommends carrying lithium battery devices in cabin baggage.
If checking, ensure AirPods are powered off and case is closed.

tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring AirPods on a plane?

airlines.name: Air France
airlines.notes: Wireless earbuds and AirPods permitted in cabin baggage. Charging case with lithium battery should travel in carry-on.

airlines.name: Emirates
airlines.notes: AirPods and wireless earbuds fully permitted in hand luggage and checked baggage.

airlines.name: British Airways

travelTips: Always travel with AirPods in your carry-on bag — the charging case has a lithium battery.
AirPods Pro and AirPods Max are allowed on all major airlines in carry-on bags.
Remove AirPods from security bin and place in carry-on before X-ray screening.

faq.question: Can I bring AirPods on a plane in my carry-on?
faq.answer: Yes! AirPods, AirPods Pro, and AirPods Max are fully allowed in carry-on bags on all airlines. The TSA permits all consumer electronics including wireless earbuds in cabin baggage.

faq.question: Can I put AirPods in my checked luggage?
faq.answer: AirPods are technically allowed in checked bags, but the charging case contains a lithium-ion battery. The FAA recommends keeping all lithium battery devices in carry-on bags so crew can access them if needed. Best practice: keep your AirPods in your carry-on.

faq.question: Do AirPods need to come out at TSA security?
faq.answer: No. AirPods do not need to be removed from your bag at TSA security checkpoints. Only laptops and large electronics need to be removed for X-ray screening.

faq.question: Are AirPods Max allowed on planes?
faq.answer: Yes. AirPods Max are fully allowed in carry-on bags. The smart case contains a small lithium battery — carry it in your hand luggage per FAA guidance.
